full_judgment: 4. On appeal by the defendants no. 1-3, the Court of appeal below by judgment and order dated 29th March, 2003 dismissed the appeal and affirmed those of the trial Court. Being aggrieved by the aforesaid judgment and decree, the respondents no. 1-3 preferred Civil Revision No. 2967 of 2003 in the High Court Division. The heirs of defendant no.20 filed an application for being added as opposite parties in the Civil Revision and to allot saham of .67 acres of land on the ground that the defendant no. 20 Altab Ali Fakir was a co-sharer in the suit khatian but he was not aware about the institution of the suit. In paragraph 4 application they narrated as to how their predecessor acquired .67 acres of land.
